Mass 3.479 (3.371 to 3.783) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5157448341659433728: teff_gspphot 5599.0347 K (16th-84th percentiles 5590.269-5609.822), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5157448341659433728: teff_gspphot 5599.0347 K (16th-84th percentiles 5590.269-5609.822), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
